name: Novalee From Tomorrow
source:
Somewhere beyond the clouds, beneath a sky scattered with countless stars, a little bunny has a rather curious question...

Where does tomorrow go before it arrives?

Meet Novalee, a curious little Almiraj who has set her heart on finding tomorrow. Surely, it must be somewhere out there, hidden among the stars, waiting patiently for someone to discover it.

And so, with a heart full of wonder and more questions than she can count, Novalee sets off into the endless night, determined to find something that no one has ever quite been able to see.

In this short, dreamlike experience, accompany Novalee on a gentle journey through the cosmos. Discover celestial wonders, ponder curious questions, and uncover little mysteries scattered across the night sky.

There are no grand battles to fight, no kingdoms to save, and no clocks to race against.

Only a little bunny, a universe full of stars, and a tomorrow waiting to be found.

After all, how can tomorrow be so close, yet always just out of reach?
